exercises.name: Translate into Kinyarwanda using the diminutive form

questions.prompt: Give me a little cob of corn.
Dore kariya kana gatoya rwose ukuntu kazi kwiruka!
questions.answer: Just look at how that tiny little child is able [knows how] to run!

questions.prompt: Dufite agahinda kenshi kubwa amakuba uriya mugore ahora agira
questions.answer: We are so sorry because of all the troubles that woman constantly experiences.

questions.prompt: Kariya kana ntigashobora kurya ibijumba binini, kuko gafit' akanwa gatoya cyane.
questions.answer: That little child cannot eat big sweet potatoes, because he has a very small mouth.

questions.prompt: Nshuti yanjye nkunda, nzi yuko utazibagirwa kwandika akandiko kambwira uk'umeze.
questions.answer: My dear friend, I know that you will not forget to write a note telling me how you are doing.

questions.prompt: Urugendo rwabaye rurerure cyane; ni cyo gituma udutsinsino twanjye tubabara
questions.answer: The journey has been very long; that's why my heels hurt.

questions.prompt: Utu twigishwa dutoya cyane tuzi kubara guhera kuri kimwe kugeza kuri makumyabiri
questions.answer: These very little students know how to count from one to twenty.
I won't eat any [some] of his meager food.

questions.prompt: Iki n'igisebe cya kane kiri ku rugingo rwe
questions.answer: This is the fourth sore [which is] on his limb

questions.prompt: Izi nka maganatatu n'eybiri n'ize; iki ni cyo gihe cya mbere nzibona
questions.answer: These 302 cows are his; this is the first time [that] I am seeing them

questions.prompt: Utu tubuto sinzadutera mu gicucu kuko dukwiriye izuba.
questions.answer: I won't plant these little seeds in the shade because they need the sun.

questions.prompt: Mpa ku matunda yawe, nanjye ndaguha ku twanjye.
questions.answer: Give me some of your fruit, and I'll give you some of the few/small ones [I have].

questions.prompt: Aka n'agahungu ka makumyabiri na gatatu; kariya n'aka makumyabiri na kane.
questions.answer: This is the twenty-third little boy; that one is the twenty-fourth.
